test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**comfort**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage highlights the emotional and spiritual benefits of reading.
 
• The correct word should reflect the sense of relief or solace that reading can provide during difficult times.
 
• "**Comfort**" fits perfectly, as it implies the emotional solace that reading can offer in sorrowful situations.
 
• Other options, such as "**resentment**", "**lethargy**", and "**oppression**", do not convey the sense of emotional support or relief described in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The habit of reading is highly advantageous to us intellectually, emotionally and spiritually. As one gets into the habit of reading, one gets mental satisfaction__. It helps us acquire **__knowledge__ and attain intellectual **__expansion__. Reading takes away our **__boredom__. Reading can bring **__comfort__** in our sorrowful times and guide us in our duties.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "**Resentment**" refers to anger or bitterness, which does not align with the idea of reading providing emotional comfort.
 
• "**Lethargy**" means sluggishness or lack of energy, which contradicts the beneficial and uplifting effect of reading.
 
• "**Oppression**" refers to prolonged cruelty or injustice, which does not fit the context of emotional relief through reading.
